init_PddlTask: initialize a PddlTask instance with config to set up PDDL problem and task spec path
reset_PddlTask: reset the PddlTask with an episode to bind PDDL problem to simulator instance
register_PddlTask: register the PddlTask class as RearrangePddlTask-v0 in the Habitat registry
bind_PddlProblem: bind the PddlProblem to a simulator instance and task during episode reset
update_articulated_agent: call maybe_update_articulated_agent on the simulator after binding PDDL problem to instance
